candidates.title: SPIRE DRIFT
candidates.description: Tap to drop a horizontally drifting block onto the growing tower; only the overlapping slice locks in, so the tower narrows and drifts faster with every imprecise drop.

candidates.title: MARQUEE HAUL
candidates.description: Drag out a rectangular box around clustered orbs; releasing captures everything fully enclosed, but a box that also encloses a hazard orb voids the whole catch.

candidates.title: PATTERN BREAK
candidates.description: A short set of tiles flashes from a grid, then the full grid lights up; tap only the tiles that were NOT part of the flash before the timer runs out.

candidates.title: ROUTE SWITCH
candidates.description: Tap junction nodes to flip which lane an oncoming pulse is routed into; the flip applies to every pulse currently approaching that junction, not just one.

candidates.title: WALL DRAW
candidates.description: Drag out a short one-time deflector wall whose position and angle come from the drag vector; drifting orbs bounce off it into a collector before it dissolves.

candidates.title: CHANNEL CATCH
candidates.description: Drag a paddle-channel left and right to intercept a ball that falls and bounces unpredictably off fixed pegs; catches near the channel's center score more than edge catches.

candidates.title: SHIELD ARC
candidates.description: Drag around a pivot to continuously rotate a shield arc that only deflects incoming projectiles whose approach angle it currently covers at the moment of contact.

candidates.title: ECHO CHAIN
candidates.description: Tap to launch a pulse that rebounds off the far wall and returns along a mirrored path; tap again exactly as it passes back through the origin zone to catch it for a bonus.

candidates.title: THREAD PULL
candidates.description: Drag away from a fixed anchor to stretch an elastic thread, where drag distance sets launch power and drag angle sets direction; release fires the payload at a drifting target.

candidates.title: PULSE SORT
candidates.description: Incoming pulses carry a size value; tap the matching small/medium/large slot while its acceptance band currently covers that value before the pulse passes by.

reason: SPIRE DRIFT scored highest overall (26) and led outright on C7: because each drop's overlap becomes the exact width of the next drop's target, a player's own imprecision directly narrows and speeds up their future decisions, which is a stronger self-compounding link between one decision and later game state than MARQUEE HAUL's per-round risk sizing or PATTERN BREAK's per-round memory recall.
